welcome.title: Know what's left from every ride.
welcome.tagline: Find out how much you really keep from your work as a ride-hailing driver.
welcome.promise: No account. No ads. Your data is yours.
welcome.privacy: Your data stays on your phone only.
welcome.terms: By continuing, you agree to the <bold>Terms of use</bold>.
welcome.region: {{language}} · {{currency}} · {{unit}}. Tap to change language and region.

intro.registerTitle: Log your day in under a minute
intro.registerBody_km: Enter what you earned, the kilometers, and the hours. The app deducts your costs and shows how much you really kept.
intro.registerBody_mi: Enter what you earned, the miles, and the hours. The app deducts your costs and shows how much you really kept.
intro.offersTitle: Evaluate offers with your own numbers
intro.offersBody: See where each offer comes from, how much you keep, and a score from 0 to 5. You decide with more clarity.

setup.title: Your cost in a few details
setup.hint: Oil, tires, and maintenance start with estimates. You can add insurance, vehicle tax, and loan payments later.

result.firstEstimate: This is a first estimate. Add insurance, vehicle tax, loan payments, or rent to see the full amount.

permissions.title: Get everything ready to use
permissions.hint: That way you don't need to stop in the middle of your shift. Everything stays on your phone, and you can change it later.
permissions.notice: You always decide on the rides: the app doesn't touch the screen. Each platform has its own rules about helper apps, and it's worth knowing them. While driving, the voice tells you: only touch your phone when the vehicle is stopped.
permissions.previewTitle: This is how an offer looks

done.title: All set
done.message: Start your shift with the round button on the bar. It's always at hand.
done.startHint: With a shift running, the same button shows the time and opens the controls.

vehicle.title_km: Find out your cost per km
vehicle.title_mi: Find out your cost per mile
vehicle.message: With it, the app shows how much you really keep from each shift.

firstShift.title: Log your first shift
firstShift.message_km: Enter how much you earned, the kilometers, and the hours. In under a minute, you see your real profit.
firstShift.message_mi: Enter how much you earned, the miles, and the hours. In under a minute, you see your real profit.

goal.title: Set your monthly goal
goal.message: Tell us how much profit you want to make and see what's left today and until the end of the month.

firstBackup.title: Keep a copy of your data
firstBackup.message: Your data is stored only on this phone. With a backup, you can take it with you if you switch devices.

fixedCosts.title: Add insurance, vehicle tax and loan payments
fixedCosts.message: Without them, your daily profit looks bigger than it is.

copilot.title: Set up the Copilot
copilot.message: It reads offers and shows right away whether the ride pays off. It takes 2 steps.
